info.prompt: A necromantic circuit board where 20 gothic spires—each representing a game genre—exchange crackling arcs of synaptic energy across precise 90-degree angles, the "Horror" spire crowned with a flickering lantern strobing at 140BPM and "Roguelike" constructed from ever-mutating bridgework, their glow casting #c8d400 and #3388ff reflections onto the engraved gridlines below crawling with parasitic binary inscriptions.
